summary: Clearwater County lookout that both main pages list as abandoned in 1926 with history unknown; no build, design or site details in sources.

facts.status_note: Both main pages say abandoned and the association list marks it Gone. No source describes what remains.

events.note: Both main pages give 1926 as the only date, beside 'history unknown'. Both also mark the lookout abandoned (firelookout.com in the same entry; Idaho Fire Lookouts as a separate status line). Neither gives a build date.

Clearwater County, coordinates, type unknown, status gone

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one date (1926), abandoned status, Drive-Up tag, elevation 2,891 ft, and the association list (type Unknown, status Gone). Two WebSearch queries and a check of the Forest Service Clearwater lookout list found nothing on this site. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives CTPA beside the elevation without explanation; the story notes only that the page does not explain it. The story sits near the 120-word floor because the evidence is this thin.
